_comment: Address ranges of large shared platforms. Thousands of unrelated shops share these addresses, so sharing one says nothing about who runs a shop; usi/shop/fingerprint.py ignores server addresses inside them. Cloudflare: https://www.cloudflare.com/ips/ (fetched 2026-09-26). Shopify: the storefront ranges its shops resolve to (checked 2026-09-26).
